resources.string: Your electric drive, at a glance.
Trip distance returns to zero. Battery energy and saved snapshots are preserved.
Drive a little to save your first snapshot.
Completed DEMO navigation and vehicle snapshots. Each section is newest first.
Accelerate, start the simulation, then save a snapshot. Your saved drives will appear here.
This saved snapshot will be permanently removed. Your active trip is preserved.
Your selection is saved on this device and restored when you return.
One real second advances 60 simulated seconds. Distance and battery update once per second while the app is visible. Background time is never added to the trip.
60 kWh battery · 0–180 km/h\nECO 0.85× · NORMAL 1.00× · SPORT 1.25×\nNormal consumption: 12.4 kWh / 100 km

The active trip survives rotation. Closing the process starts a fresh trip at 65% battery; saved snapshots and driving mode stay on the device. Temperatures are fixed demo values. There is no charging or regenerative braking model.
Could not save snapshot. Please try again.
Could not delete snapshot. Please try again.
Could not save driving mode. Please try again.
Your local library and optional Spotify controls.
Audio plays in the Spotify app. Disconnecting releases controls; it does not stop Spotify playback. Account and queue restrictions apply.
Start a track or playlist in Spotify, then return here. Play resumes the existing Spotify queue.
Choose audio you own or have permission to use. Local playback pauses in the background and stays available without Spotify.
No audio files selected. Add files from this device to build your library.
Add your Client ID and exact registered HTTPS redirect URI to spotify.properties, then rebuild. See docs/SPOTIFY.md. No client secret is needed.
Spotify is not installed. Use Open Spotify to visit its store page, install it, and sign in.
Open Spotify and sign in, then return and connect again.
Spotify authorization was not granted. Connect again and approve playback control. Check your developer-app test-user access.
Check the Client ID, registered redirect URI, Android package, signing SHA-1, and developer-user allowlist in Spotify Dashboard, then rebuild if configuration changed.
Open Spotify, disable offline mode, and check your internet connection before reconnecting.
Update the Spotify app. This installed version does not support the requested feature.
Spotify disconnected. Open Spotify and reconnect to restore controls.
Could not connect. Open Spotify, check sign-in and network access, and retry. Check the developer configuration if it continues.
Spotify did not respond. Open Spotify and check sign-in, network, and consent, then reconnect.
Spotify rejected that control. Check account, queue, and content restrictions in Spotify, then retry. No restriction is bypassed.
Return to AutoHMI before connecting to Spotify.
Some audio files could not be read. Select them again using a provider that supports persistent access; check that the files still exist.
This audio file could not be played. Check access and format, or choose another file.
